records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Hope the first few days with Wrenfield have been smooth. If you'd like, I can help you set up a first project so you're not starting from a blank page.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Orchard Media!
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone. Three Wrenfield outreach emails (email:dbeddbc1, email:49ac387f, email:3b2712e5) all unanswered, no tickets, no customer-written message at all. Silent, disengaged Starter accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

I know the first week can get away from you. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually enough to see how it fits your work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project whenever you're ready.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to sit with you while you set up that first project and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
